ValidationRule.description: If the Revenue Share Agreement at the Account is checked, Contract record field cannot be blank. Must require of a Contract record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name = "Agents", Probability >0.90, ISBLANK(ContractId), OR( Account.Revenue_Share_Agreement__c = TRUE, Contract_Not_Required__c = False), OR( ISBLANK(Contract.ActivatedDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Contract.OBS_Flywire_Entity__c)), ISBLANK(Contract.StartDate), ISBLANK(Contract.EndDate) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account has Rev. Share Agreement, provide a Contract record. If Contract is not Required check *Contract Not Required*.
